observations.atomic_claim: A context with a live Tiptap editor plus html, text, selectedText, selection {from,to}, and documentVersion is accepted; default input composition uses the snapshot values even when the live editor text changes after generate starts.
observations.surface: AiEditorContext live editor and snapshot fields

observations.atomic_claim: executeEditorFunctionTool('missing','{}',context).output equals {ok:false,error:'Unknown editor tool: missing'}; applyEditorToolProposal(editor, version, proposal with tool missing and matching documentVersion) returns ok:false and leaves editor text unchanged.
observations.surface: unknown tool execution and apply behavior

observations.atomic_claim: With stream:true, editorTools:true, and a streamed tool round that ends without a completed model response, generate rejects with 'AI response stream ended before completion' rather than returning partial text.
Preserve observable behavior for exports:./package.json

A valid pending proposal becomes status applied and returns {ok:true,message:'Applied to the document.'}; a tool throwing Error('boom') returns {ok:false,message:'boom'}; a tool throwing the non-Error value 'boom' returns {ok:false,message:'Could not apply this proposal.'}.
observations.surface: valid and failing proposal apply results

observations.atomic_claim: createAiService({provider:'custom',generate:async()=> 'ok'}).generate(request,context) resolves {text:'ok'}; a custom generate returning {text:'x'} preserves {text:'x'}; createAiService(existingService) returns the same existing instance.
observations.surface: custom service and existing service handling

observations.atomic_claim: generate({prompt:'p',instructions:'Be brief'}, context) sends 'Be brief' as model-level instructions while the user text contains only the prompt composition; concatenating the instructions into user text fails.

package.json main is ./dist/index.cjs, module is ./dist/index.js, exports.import points to dist/index.js and dist/index.d.ts, exports.require points to dist/index.cjs and dist/index.d.cts; the built package adds no UMD bundle and no browser-global AiEditor constructor.
observations.surface: package entry points and ESM/CJS publication

observations.atomic_claim: TypeScript consumers can import every listed AI type by its existing name; assigning a current AiGenerateRequest, AiEditorContext, OpenAiServiceConfig, and AiEditorToolProposal to fixtures with the documented members compiles without removing or widening a member.

registerAiProvider({id:'',name:'n',model:'m'}) throws 'AI provider id cannot be empty'; blank name and model throw their corresponding messages; registering {id:'x',name:'X',model:'m'} replaces x with a frozen copy so mutating the input does not change getAiProvider('x').
Preserve observable behavior for exports:./style.css

With editorTools:true and a model that requests a tool call on every round, generate performs at most eight model rounds and rejects with 'AI exceeded the maximum editor tool call rounds'; issuing a ninth model request fails.

package.json exports the import condition to dist/index.js with dist/index.d.ts and the require condition to dist/index.cjs with dist/index.d.cts; the built package has no UMD export and no browser-global AiEditor constructor.
A provider {id:'p',name:'P',model:'m'} and a provider with an added baseURL 'https://example.test/v1' both satisfy AiProviderDefinition; omitting id, name, or model fails type-check.
generate({prompt:'go'}, context) resolves text equal to the final model output; with editorTools:true and model text rounds 'a' then 'b', it resolves text 'ab'.
observations.surface: non-streaming final-output and cross-round text accumulation

observations.atomic_claim: generate({prompt:'hello'}, context) resolves an object with text and optional raw and toolProposals; generate({prompt:'   '}, context) rejects with 'AI prompt cannot be empty'.

The migration changes only src/ai/OpenAiService.ts, src/ai/index.ts, src/ai/Providers.ts, src/ai/types.ts, src/ai/editor-tools.ts, package.json, and the target dependency lockfile update; editor UI, Tiptap, sanitization, uploader, and localization files remain byte-identical to the baseline.

generate({prompt:'go',stream:true}, context) with text deltas a, b, c calls onChunk in that order and resolves text 'abc'; providing only onChunk also streams, and the same ordering holds with editorTools:true.
